title: Goodstein at the Second Threshold: An Independence Result for $ID_2$
summary: The classical Goodstein process, defined via hereditary base-$k$ exponential normal form, is a well-known example of a principle unprovable in Peano Arithmetic. In this paper, we generalize this framework by constructing a new Goodstein process based on the Hardy hierarchy. We develop an ordinal notation system utilizing a two-step collapsing procedure, which yields a proof-theoretic ordinal of $ψ_0ψ_1(\varepsilon_{Ω_2+1})$.
